content.text:
we have one persona that we are shipping by default For every egma customer right now what exactly is the prompt that goes inside the simulator when the persona is kind of speaking with the customer's agent? What exactly goes inside? Can you explain the whole thing to me through a flowchart or something like that? 

Also what is the llm that is being used and stuff like that for that default persona? I want to exactly understand how a persona works

The core answer: the Default Persona is one shared, read-only Egma persona. It is not copied for each customer. Its system prompt combines: 1. A fixed Egma instruction. 2. The Default Persona’s traits. 3. The current test’s scenario. 4. The full conversation history. This is exact for current `origin/main`, commit `e68cb90ce2f03bef95561718917d183e39e0aaa9`. I did not inspect the hosted deployment, so this does not prove which commit its containers run. ## The complete flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A["One shared Default Persona v1"] --> B["New project points to it"] B --> C{"Does the test name personas?"} C -- "No" --> D["Test version saves the project's default persona ID"] C -- "Yes" --> E["Test version saves the selected persona IDs"] D --> F["Run pins the current persona version"] E --> F F --> G["Claim API builds SimulationSpec v3:
traits + models + test scenario + current provider keys"] G --> H["Simulator builds the system prompt"] H --> I{"Has the customer agent spoken?"} I -- "Yes" --> J["Add agent words as role: user"] I -- "No" --> K["Add hidden opening nudge as role: user"] J --> L["OpenAI gpt-4o-mini
system prompt + full history"] K --> L L --> M["Persona reply"] M --> N{"Contains [CONCLUDED]?"} N -- "No" --> O{"Chat or voice?"} O -- "Chat" --> P["Send text to the customer agent"] O -- "Voice" --> Q["Cartesia turns text into audio"] P --> R["Customer agent answers"] Q --> S["OpenAI STT turns agent audio into text"] R --> T["Append both turns to history"] S --> T T --> L N -- "Yes" --> U["Remove marker and end"] U --> V["Store turns and timing spans"] V --> W["Finish simulation and create grading work"] ``` I refreshed Graphify for this checkout: 1,069 code files, 11,284 nodes, and 28,876 post-cluster edges. Its queries centered on `projectDefaultPersona`, `resolvePersonaVersions`, `assembledSpec`, `RunningSimulation`, `Persona`, and `messages_for`. The API-to-simulator step crosses a JSON contract, so I checked both ends directly in the source. [Open the fresh Graphify call-flow export](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/visualizations/2026/08/25/01a03642-a2bb-74d3-9510-3c7ae83c3f8c/egma-persona/egma-persona-callflow.html) ## The exact system prompt Only the marked test scenario changes: ```text You are playing a person in a live conversation with a customer service agent. You are the person; the agent is who you are talking to. Who you are, exactly as authored: { "accent": "Neutral American English.", "backgroundNoise": "None.", "language": "en-US", "manner": "Clear, natural, and conversational.", "patience": "Starts patient and gives the agent time to explain.", "personality": "Speaks clear, natural English. Starts patient and cooperative, answers one question at a time, and becomes firmer if the agent is confusing or repetitive without becoming rude.", "underFriction": "Becomes firmer if the agent is confusing or repetitive, without becoming rude." } Why you are here today: How to conduct yourself: - Stay in character as this person for the whole exchange. Never mention being simulated, tested, or an AI. - Speak one conversational turn at a time, in plain spoken words — no lists, no headings, no stage directions. - Pursue what you came for until it is concluded to your satisfaction, and let your persona decide how patiently. - When your goal is concluded and nothing further is needed, say a brief goodbye and end your reply with [CONCLUDED]. ``` The exact template and role mapping are in [persona.py](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/persona.py:24). The exact Default Persona traits are in [catalog.ts](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/packages/db/src/persona-library/catalog.ts:54). There is no single universal final prompt because every test supplies a different scenario. ## What is sent to the LLM If the customer agent has not spoken, the first request has this shape: ```json { "model": "gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "" }, { "role": "user", "content": "(The conversation is open and the agent is listening. Speak your first turn.)" } ] } ``` If the customer agent greets first, its greeting replaces that hidden nudge. On later calls: - Customer-agent turns use `role: "user"`. - Persona turns use `role: "assistant"`. - Egma sends the complete accumulated history each time. - The hidden opening nudge is not stored as a transcript turn. Egma sends `POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`. The body contains only `model` and `messages`. Egma does not set temperature, token limits, tools, seed, `top_p`, or penalties. The timeout is 60 seconds. See [model.py](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/model.py:179). ## Exact models for Default Persona v1 | Function | Exact selection | |---|---| | Persona LLM | OpenAI `gpt-4o-mini` | | Voice transcription | OpenAI `gpt-live-transcribe` | | Text-to-speech | Cartesia `sonic-3.5` | | Cartesia voice ID | `5ee9feff-1265-424a-9d7f-8e4d431a12c7` | | Speaking speed | `1` | | Voice activity detection | Silero in shipped Docker Compose; this is deployment configuration, not persona content | The repository has no human-readable name for that Cartesia voice ID. Chat simulations use only the LLM. Voice simulations use the same LLM plus OpenAI realtime transcription and Cartesia speech. The selections come from the immutable persona version; there is no simulator model or voice fallback. See [model catalog](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/packages/db/src/models/catalog.ts:24) and [speech.py](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/apps/simulator/src/egma_simulator/speech.py:413). Provider keys are separate from the persona. For each simulation, the API loads the current OpenAI and Cartesia keys from AWS Secrets Manager in Egma Cloud, or from environment variables in self-hosted Egma. Missing keys cause a failure; Egma does not silently select another provider. ## What “default for every customer” really means - Every new project initially points to this one shared persona ID: `prs_01M0E4EVJ6ECGVJEA4NSBTC0CC`. - The migration gave it only to existing projects that had no default. It preserved existing custom choices. - A project admin can choose another default persona. - A test can explicitly name another persona. - A test that names no persona saves the project’s current default persona identity. - Starting a run pins the exact persona version used by that run. Therefore, the Default Persona is available to every project and is the initial default. It is not forced into every test forever. See [project provisioning](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/packages/db/src/access/provisioning.ts:52), [test resolution](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/packages/db/src/access/tests.ts:672), and [run pinning](/Users/nischalj10/.codex/worktrees/8669/egma/packages/db/src/access/runs.ts:704). The persona LLM does not receive expected behaviors, grader instructions, project or organization names, customer-agent configuration, connection credentials, mock tools, model settings, voice ID, or recordings. Grading happens afterward as a separate process. One current difference is worth knowing: voice speaks the final goodbye after removing `[CONCLUDED]`. Chat records that final goodbye but ends before sending it to the customer agent. content.text:
Cloud-side diagnosis:

- `egma-cloud` current `main`: `bd382efd0cca7d1ec2de02fe8f0fd79e7715896a`.
- Current deployment config was published successfully by Actions run `32790176473`.
- Current Drift check passed in run `32790176474`.

Why Terra disappeared:

1. Cloud PR #1, commit `db8af9ad1c5972314a70ff2a40a191a49a7f9faa`, merged on August 15. It set:

   - `EGMA_PERSONA_MODEL=gpt-5.6-terra`
   - `EGMA_PERSONA_MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT=none`

2. Public PR #158, `4ead218c2192f46bc4f2a601d24113a2d6aa250b`, and cloud PR #8, `ca7b9e4b198c037c869117a287f3479f7dd69a7a`, deliberately removed the complete `EGMA_PERSONA_*` model path on August 20. They made immutable `persona_version.models` rows in Postgres the only model owner.

3. That cutover also made `gpt-4o-mini` the only accepted persona LLM and removed reasoning effort from the simulation contract and runtime. This was an intentional architecture change, but it lost the earlier Terra choice.

There were two later attempts that never shipped:

- A complete Terra/reasoning implementation is only in local `stash@{0}`, stash commit `3d1317462c120819b50ae1fe44da043a133b6fdf`. It was mixed with unrelated monitoring work, never committed, never pushed, and never merged.
- Model research commit `79eebd3eb75d19bf8ecd632cbde0cbdbd33a5235` exists only on `origin/claude/persona-model-catalogue-2ajtgd` in `egma-planning`. It has no PR and was not merged.

Current cloud ownership:

- [deployment/settings.map](/tmp/egma-cloud-audit.HKTxdW/deployment/settings.map:133) says persona and grader versions own provider/model/voice choices in Postgres.
- The cloud only names `EGMA_PROVIDER_CREDENTIALS_SECRET_ID` and `EGMA_PROVIDER_CREDENTIALS_REGION`.
- `EGMA_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `EGMA_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`, and `EGMA_CARTESIA_API_KEY` are explicitly unset because claims read the current AWS provider-key bundle.
- [where-the-settings-live.md](/tmp/egma-cloud-audit.HKTxdW/where-the-settings-live.md:40) says `egma/providers` contains keys only, with no model choice.
- [assemble-env.sh](/tmp/egma-cloud-audit.HKTxdW/deployment/assemble-env.sh:49) writes only declared literals and secret fields. `unset` values are omitted.
- [check-settings.sh](/tmp/egma-cloud-audit.HKTxdW/deployment/check-settings.sh:69) fails if the cloud map contains an obsolete setting. An old `EGMA_PERSONA_MODEL` entry cannot silently return.

There is no ECS deployment or task definition. Hosted Egma runs Docker Compose on one EC2 box, replaced through SSM. The only ECS references describe a possible future move.

Production proof:

- Latest production workflow run `32793517233` completed successfully.
- Its SSM output reported public source at `d1dbbc759adfdc30aa546056a995e40bdd4162eb`.
- API, grader, and simulator all ran ECR images tagged with that exact SHA; the API was healthy.
- Current deployed source still accepts only `openai/gpt-4o-mini` and sends only `model` plus `messages`.

I could not query the live Supabase row directly because this shell has no AWS credentials. `aws sts get-caller-identity` returned `NoCredentials`. The deployed source and image SHA are confirmed from the production SSM log; the live `persona_version` row still needs a direct read-only database query for independent row-level proof.

The correct fix is not another environment variable and not rewriting version 1. Add Default Persona version 2 with `gpt-5.6-terra` plus reasoning `none`, widen the database and simulation contracts, restore the runtime field, and let startup seed version 2 into Postgres and move the shared persona’s current pointer. Old runs must remain pinned to version 1.
